item.description: Christopher Barzak’s A Voice Calling is a novella about a haunted house; it is, more specifically, about the community haunted by the presence of a haunted house. The narrative voice, fascinatingly, is in the first person plural, which occasionally devolves into disagreements, collective selfishness, and arch judgment, much as a small town itself might.
